# Google Material Icons subset

PandaWave vendors 21 legacy Material Icons Outlined vectors at 24dp from
[google/material-design-icons](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons/tree/0cbb08816df07faaae3dca060d4ebb10b66c214f),
pinned to commit `0cbb08816df07faaae3dca060d4ebb10b66c214f`.
They back 22 semantic properties; Library and MusicLibrary share one asset.

The [Apache License 2.0](../../third_party/material-design-icons/LICENSE) is retained locally.
Each copied XML identifies its modifications: vector-level theme tint was removed
so Compose supplies tint, and upstream auto-mirroring was retained for queue_music,
volume_down, and volume_up. Path geometry is unchanged.

PandaWave launcher, logo, paw, and splash branding resources are unrelated to this subset.
